name: look
description: Check a project in one call instead of sampling frames: overlay text off the frame, cut off by its box, spilling out of its box, inside the 5% title-safe margin, crossing the captions while one shows (where montaj draws them, measured per style), over the apps' bottom controls or right-side buttons (tall phone frames only), overlays whose text crosses, items outside the timeline or past the footage, missing overlay files, black stretches, overlays with no footage under them (overlay only), items a full-frame one hides. Picks the times itself (cut seams, overlay in and out, caption changes, even samples; at most 12) unless at is given. Read-only, renders no frame. image adds one contact sheet.

input.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

output.description: {ok, overlays (measured), unmeasured?, issues?: ["<t>s <id>: <issue>"], more?, sheet?, times?}. detail adds every issue, times, items, notes, wallMs.

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

params.name: at
params.description: Look at these timeline seconds instead (at most 12; 8 with image).

params.name: image
params.description: Also make one contact sheet of at most 8 of the times (3 across, 360 px tiles) in render/samples.

params.name: detail
params.description: Also answer the times, each item checked and the wall time.
